provenance_vs_carrier.purpose: Scientific provenance and reproducibility carrier are DISTINCT. provenance_tier / source_* describe WHERE a fact scientifically comes from. reproducibility_carrier_* describes the tracked clean-checkout artifact that reproduces the displayed value when the scientific source is itself untracked or prose-only. An untracked or prose-only source is NEVER promoted to clean-checkout reproducibility.

D1 real-behavior claims: provenance_tier = local_untracked_accepted (D1 evidence.json is local, never committed); reproducibility carrier = tracked S5 coverage matrix where the presentation relies on clean-checkout reproducibility.

provenance_tiers.local_untracked_accepted: Local accepted evidence on disk; NOT tracked in Git; sha256 recorded; not clean-checkout reproducible as a scientific source. A tracked reproducibility carrier (S5 coverage matrix) reproduces the displayed facts textually.
